changeSet.author: claude
changeSet.comment: Household inspection photos move from base64 text in gis_inspection_photo to the shared attachment store (file on the private attachment folder, metadata row here) under owner kind HOUSEHOLD, owner = household roster id. Existing photos are moved by the application at start-up (InspectionPhotoMigration), keeping their ids; rows it cannot move stay in gis_inspection_photo and are still served from there.
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE attachment DROP CONSTRAINT attachment_owner_kind_check; ALTER TABLE attachment ADD CONSTRAINT attachment_owner_kind_check CHECK (owner_kind IN ('RESIDENT','FACILITY','GUIDANCE','HOUSEHOLD'));
